title: install-links -J record
description: One directory or symlink `install-links -J` made, in place of its summary line. Error records (`#/$defs/error`) are in the same stream. One record per line (NDJSON); version 1 of the Dogfish record format (doc/ndjson.md). Fields may be added in later releases.

action.description: `mkdir`, a directory made for TARGET_DIR (outermost first); `symlink`, a link made to the dogfish binary.

path_bytes.description: The bytes of `path`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`path` then holds the lossy form).

source.description: Of symlink: what the link points to, the dogfish binary.

source_bytes.description: The bytes of `source`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`source` then holds the lossy form).

dest.description: Of symlink: the link, in TARGET_DIR.

dest_bytes.description: The bytes of `dest`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`dest` then holds the lossy form).

error.description: An error record: the structured twin of a diagnostic the tool also printed on standard error, in order with the other records.
The diagnostic as printed on standard error, without the `tool: ` prefix.

path.description: The file the diagnostic names first, as given.

path_bytes.description: The bytes of `path`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`path` then holds the lossy form).

errno.description: The system error number, when the diagnostic ends with its message (2 for `No such file or directory`).
